entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! This is absolutely ridiculous. I need to return this VeloBand tracker and your website is giving me the runaround. I want my money back, and I want it now!
I can certainly understand your frustration, and I'm here to help sort this out. So I can pull up your account, could you please provide me with your order number?
It's VF8675309. Look, I don't have time for a big song and dance. Just process the return.
Thank you, I'm pulling that up now. And just so I can properly document this, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's not a fault, I haven't even opened the box! I had a major medical **emergency** right after I bought it. I was stuck in the **hospital** for three weeks and had to have unexpected **surgery**. This return was the last thing on my mind. If you don't refund me, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Get me your manager!
I'm very sorry to hear you went through that; it sounds incredibly difficult, and a manager won't be necessary. Let me take a look at the return eligibility for you right now. Just one moment.
Yeah, whatever. I already know what you're going to say. It was a gift for my son who is on military **deployment**, but now things have changed and I just need the money back.

Okay, I have your order details here. It was delivered on December 16th. According to my system, our standard return policy is 90 days from the date of delivery. You are well within that timeframe, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you today.
Wait, what? 90 days? Are you sure? The email I got said something completely different. So you can just... take it back? No fight?

Yes, I'm sure. You are well within the 90-day window. I've gone ahead and initiated that return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply print it out, attach it to the unopened box, and drop it off at a post office. Your refund will be issued as soon as our warehouse receives it.
Oh. Well... that's... a lot easier than I expected. Okay then. Thank you, Charlie. I appreciate that.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could get this resolved for you. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope the rest of your day is a good one.
